name: @inverz/delivery-status
description: Parcel tracking for React: paste one or many tracking numbers, detect the carrier and show a Thai delivery timeline. Server helper set up from .env: Thailand Post, Flash, J&T, Ninja Van, DHL eCommerce, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop, TrackingMore, 17TRACK, Track123, AfterShip, Ship24

scripts.build: npm run env:example && vite build && cp src/style.css src/index.d.ts src/core.d.ts src/server.d.ts dist/
scripts.deploy:demo: npm run build:demo && rm -rf ../hosting/public/deliverystatus && cp -R demo-dist ../hosting/public/deliverystatus && firebase deploy --only hosting --config ../hosting/firebase.json

keywords: ติดตามพัสดุ
ไปรษณีย์ไทย
author: Inverz Solutions Co.,Ltd.
